reference: The Standard Savings Account pays 0.20% per annum, calculated on the minimum monthly balance and credited half yearly.
answer:

- The interest is calculated based on the minimum monthly balance. [2]

question: Do I pay anything to open an account?
reference: No. The account opening fee is free.
answer: - No, you do not pay anything to open an account. [1]

question: What is charged if I close my account soon after opening it?
reference: An account closure fee of AED 105 applies if the account is closed within 6 months of opening.
answer: - If you close your account within 6 months of opening it, a fee of AED 105 will be charged. [1]

question: What happens if several of my cheques bounce in one year?
reference: According to UAE Central Bank instructions, the account will be closed and added to the blacklist if 4 cheques are returned unpaid due to insufficient balance within one year.
answer: - If four cheques are returned unpaid due to insufficient balance within a period of one year, your bank account will be closed and added to the blacklist according to the instructions of the UAE Central Bank. [1]

question: Can I change my mind after signing the account application?
reference: Yes. The cooling-off period allows cancelling within five (5) business days of signing the application, by giving the bank notice.
answer: - Yes, you can change your mind after signing the account application within five business days. [1]

question: Which savings account lets family members combine their balances for a better rate?
reference: The Family Savings Account, for UAE Nationals only, gives higher interest of 1.50% to 2.50% per annum based on pooled family balances.
answer: - The Family Savings Account lets family members combine their balances for a better interest rate. [1]

question: How many withdrawals per month are allowed on the Plus Saver account?
reference: Up to 5 monthly withdrawals are allowed; exceeding this results in a lower interest rate for the month.
answer: - Up to 5 monthly withdrawals are allowed on the Plus Saver account. [1]

question: Do accounts opened for children get charged when the balance falls below the minimum?
reference: No. Savings accounts for minors are exempt from the minimum balance requirement and are not charged a fall below fee until the holder turns 18.
answer: - Accounts opened for minors (individuals below the age of 18 years) are exempt from the minimum monthly balance maintenance requirement and will not be charged a fall below fee. [1]

question: If I put money in the Gold Account, will I receive physical gold?
reference: No. There is no physical delivery or storage of gold or silver for amounts in these accounts.
answer: - No, you will not receive physical gold if you put money in the Gold Account. [1]

question: What interest rate does the Special Current Account pay?

answer: - The Special Current Account pays an interest rate of 0.10% per annum. [1]

question: How much is charged for each returned cheque?
reference: AED 105 is charged per returned cheque.
answer: - Each returned cheque is charged AED 105. [1]
